newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mobil confirms Mar 15 for Singapore refinery check.
newsitem.headline: Mobil confirms Mar 15 for Singapore refinery check.

text.p: Mobil Oil Singapore, a unit of U.S. oil giant Mobil Corp, said on Wednesday it planned to start a maintenance turnaround at its 280,000 barrels per day (bpd) refinery on March 15.
The turnaround would last about one month, a statement said.
The statement said the Jurong plant on the west coast of Singapore would also carry out debottlenecking to raise output capacity to 300,000 bpd.
The statement did not say how much capacity would be shut down during the turnaround.
But in January industry sources said that effectively the whole refinery would be shut down during this period, although a 45,000 bpd crude distillation unit (CDU) might be kept operational.

Mobil said in its statement that during the turnaround period some equipment at the refinery would be modified as part of a U.S. $250 million lube base-oil plant due onstream in the second quarter of 1997.
